headline: UAH concede once in three wins
dek: UAH have let in one goal in three matches and scored ten, and the win at Georgia Southwestern was their second away from home. AUM and Trevecca are unbeaten too, and the three have won all nine matches they have played between them; no other programme has won more than once.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring at the top is not one striker's doing: UAH's ten goals have come from seven different players.

wire.line: Union have lost all three of their matches, more defeats than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have passed their date with no result at all, the earliest Trevecca's at Belmont, and no final has been left without a score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Union's defeat to Kentucky Wesleyan is the one published result with no detail behind it: no box-score link on any collected schedule page.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lee are unbeaten, with one win and two draws, and have conceded two goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Delta State have scored once all season, Tazjean Bird's goal at Harding, and that was the match they won.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hunter Walker has kept clean sheets in two of Trevecca's three matches.

last_match.line: Mississippi Christian's first win of the season, and their first clean sheet.

next_match.line: UAH have yet to drop a point; Tuskegee have already won at Union.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
